title: The 8 Levels of Ex-Partner Stalking
house: A buzzing, sun-drenched suburban district where fruit and vegetable citizens commute in neon-lit subway cars, grab iced coffees at corner bodegas, and check their glowing digital forehead badges on every block.
catchphrase: The number on your forehead never tells the full obsession.

levels.name: Chloe, 24, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-partner stalking. Level 1. Level 1: 3 hours a day spent scrolling through my ex's new girlfriend's dog walker's vacation photos from 2021. I am Chloe, 24, working the morning shift at the neon juice bar with a bright digital 1 glowing right above my bruised blueberry eyebrows. My thumb aches, my Wi-Fi bill is past due at $85, and I am knee-deep in a digital rabbit hole. Hey Chloe, another double shot of espresso for table four please! Then she walked in. A crisp, polished orange with an intimidating glowing 5 on her forehead walked straight up to my register, holding her iced matcha latte. Get over him already, sweetie, he dumped you for a reason. I froze, my heart dropping straight into my soggy apron pocket. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Marcus, 28, Delivery Rider
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-partner stalking. Level 2. Level 2: 14 fake Instagram profiles blocked and counting, yet I still track his geotags through reflections in his spoons. I am Marcus, 28, zipping through the rainy downtown traffic on my electric scooter with a glowing 2 on my forehead and soggy cardboard boxes strapped to my back. My rent is $1,850 a month, and my life is total chaos. Package for penthouse four! Hurry up, delivery guy! While dropping off a package at a luxury high-rise, I spotted him: a sleek, arrogant red apple with a blazing 6 on his forehead, casually scrolling through high-resolution drone footage of my ex's new apartment. Keep zooming in, delivery boy, you'll never afford a front-row seat to their actual life. My blood boiled, my electric scooter battery flashed red, and my forehead badge pulsed dangerously. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Zoe, 26, Data Analyst
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-partner stalking. Level 3. Level 3: 500 screenshots organized into color-coded folders labeled Evidence and Timelines. I am Zoe, 26, working graveyard shifts in a fluorescent cubicle maze with a steady 3 glowing on my smooth peach forehead. My student debt is sitting at $34,200, and my eyes burn from staring at metadata until 5 AM. Zoe, server four just crashed again, check the mainframe logs! Tonight, the system flagged a massive data breach originating from my ex's new partner's IP address. You're looking in all the wrong folders, little peach, they moved to Paris yesterday. My chest tightened, my coffee mug shattered on the linoleum floor, and my forehead badge blinked erratically. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Leo, 31, Security Guard
levels.story: The 8 levels of ex-partner stalking. Level 4. Level 4: 12 different IP addresses spoofed just to view a public story without triggering notifications. I am Leo, 31, patrolling the damp subway platforms with a steady 4 glowing on my rugged avocado forehead. My rent is $1,400 a month, and my life is built around digital walls. Excuse me guard, the northbound express train is delayed by ten minutes! While checking the turnstiles, I noticed a tall, silent turnip with a mysterious glowing 8 on his forehead holding a printed copy of my entire search history. Your firewall is a joke, Leo, and your ex doesn't even remember your last name. My green skin turned pale, my flashlight flickered and died, and my forehead badge surged with static electricity. You'll see that in Level 5.
